caption: The drawing depicts a rustic wooden chair with a simple design, rendered in colors including shades of brown, green, and hints of yellow. The chair features two vertical back posts that end in rounded finials, connected by two horizontal slats that form the backrest. The seat appears to be made from a material stretched over the frame, showing signs of wear and damage including a noticeable tear. The legs are cylindrical and slightly angled outward for stability, with stretchers connecting the legs on all sides; the front stretcher has a greenish tint, in contrast with the otherwise natural wood tones. The overall composition is centered on the page, with a faint border sketched around the image and a signature below the drawing. The background is plain, emphasizing the chair as the focal point.
title: Child's chair
